_meta.directives: A dossier is shared across relevant atlas fiches and discovered through editorial themes. Cite every prose block, reading and figure. Numerical thesis figures are optional (zero to three). A chapter may omit paired readings; if a comparison is included, publish both sourced perspectives. Illustrations may be null; otherwise retain attribution, licence and original file links. Distinguish political formations, peoples and present-day countries. Record uncertainty in gaps. Keep stable identifiers and URLs.
